title: Event Ledger — draft 0.1.0
description: Append-only record of adoption and effect events (piece 4 of the NGA unified-architecture growth layer). An event carries the three-layer business identity (07 proposal §6 objects T1/J1-D1/B1), the accountability triple (festival D31), the P5 five-dimension version binding, and the correlation keys the replay matcher (piece 6) consumes: operation identity, payload digest, dependency versions, and the recorded arbitration order (07 §8 retention list). The adopt state machine (piece 2) is the single writer; replay (piece 6) is a reader; nothing else writes. Replay re-uses the recorded order, never re-arbitrates (legacy 12号 §3 semantics — not re-stated in the current proposal; see the drift register in schema/README.md). Record-family inputs (model outputs, tool responses, provider receipts) are NOT stored here — piece 6 fixtures supply them (S1 fork ruling; the current proposal's retention list covers them separately, see the drift register). Provenance (dual anchor): semantics per the current NGA architecture proposal §3/§6/§8 and overall-design P5; formerly NGA overall-design §7.2 / P5, 12-replay-and-audit-contract §2-§3, 15-graph-loop §B4 (superseded by the 2026-10-31 consolidation). All 'proposed' status in NGA — every field here is an evidence-track probe answer, not an NGA commitment.

event_type.description: adoption = the control gate committed a decision; effect = an external operation was dispatched or its outcome recorded; control = the machine REFUSED an attempt on an adopted operation (14-A4 revocation rejection, illegal-transition rejection) — an audit fact that never transitions state and never enters the idempotency registry (E3, 2026-11-03: a refusal record is a first-class persistent event, not a discarded return value). Four operation types (inspect/replay/reevaluate/recover — proposal §8's four modes) enter as structured callers of the state machine, not as event types.

arbitration_seq.description: Monotonic per-ledger sequence recording which concurrent competitor won (proposal §8 retention: 'arbitration order'). Replay re-uses the recorded order, never re-arbitrates (legacy 12 §2 semantics — not re-stated in the current proposal; see the drift register L5 in schema/README.md). Integer LITERAL only, enforced by the checker rules on both oracle sides ([LEDGER.SEQ_FLOAT_SYNTAX] / [EVIDLOG.SEQ_FLOAT_SYNTAX]) — JSON Schema cannot express this (pattern matches strings only, and its integer type accepts 1.0 by value), so the literal-domain rule lives in code, keyed neutrally (user ruling 2026-11-02: this package does no float math — machine counter domain).

grants_at_decision.description: Grant set pinned at the decision point (adoption events only). It rides the event because the event file is the adopt machine's only durable state — without it, a crash would make the dispatch-time revocation check vacuous (pin content while rechecking applicable live authority — proposal §7 commit boundary, M05).

outcome.description: The event's verdict. A 'conflict' outcome records a lost race, not an error (same-key/different-material-content is a conflict — proposal §3). An 'unresolved' state on the effect path records dispatch-with-unknown-outcome (M07/M08). A 'rejected' status records a control-plane refusal (E3): it rides control events only — the attempt's audit fact, never a state transition.

detail.description: Free-text provenance for the human reader; not a machine-checked field.

accountability.description: Festival D31 accountability triple — orthogonal to the business identity; both ride the same event (their join point).

identity.description: Three-layer business identity (NGA §7.2). Retries/recovery reuse operation_id; a new evaluation under new versions is a new evaluation_revision linked to the same business_request_id.

versions.description: P5 five-dimension version binding. A model version name is an address, not a substitute for the actual output — outputs live in piece-6 record-family fixtures. Divergence register: overall-design P5 names five version dimensions (evidence included), while the proposal's §6 decision object lists four (evidence as facts/provenance, not a version) — whether evidence is a version dimension is an unresolved upstream ruling; festival implements five, all required. Evidence is included from day one (P5 names it first).

idempotency.description: The replay matcher's key: operation identity + payload digest + dependency versions. Same key + same digest = reuse; same key + different digest = reject (proposal §3 command paragraph: 'Same command identity with unchanged material content resolves the original receipt; changed content does not silently replace it'; §7: a client key alone gives no server guarantee).

payload_digest.description: sha256 hex of JCS(request payload) — same shape and stack as the base's ContractHash.

grant.description: One entry of a grant set. Shape is shared with the adoption contract schema (each schema stays self-contained, frozen-engine stake C5-a); the two copies are kept in lockstep by a direct subtree diff in ledger.py plus the fixture suites on both sides.
